title: Treasury coupon announcement (2Y + 5Y + 7Y notes, 2Y FRN reopening, 52-week and 13/26/6-week bills) — the Thanksgiving-week block, and the month's largest nominal-coupon release
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), re-fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 by this event's own initial research (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes), text layer decompressed stream-by-stream and re-tokenised into 213 (security, announce, auction, settle) rows. EIGHT rows carry announce date `Thursday, November 19, 2026`, exactly the eight the proposing sweep named — `13-Week BILL` + `26-Week BILL` + `2-Year NOTE` (auction Monday, November 23, 2026), `6-Week BILL` + `52-Week BILL` + `2-Year FRN R` + `5-Year NOTE` (auction Tuesday, November 24, 2026), and `7-Year NOTE` (auction Wednesday, November 25, 2026). The three notes settle Monday, November 30, 2026; the four bills and the FRN settle Friday, November 27, 2026, a SIFMA-recommended bond early close. Composition INDEPENDENTLY RE-DERIVED and CONFIRMED UNCHANGED against the proposal, which is the first time in this series a proposal needed no composition correction. Stays estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the announcement itself. The ~11:00am ET announcement slot is standing convention inherited from the sibling coupon-announcement ledgers and is NOT separately sourced; the AUCTION times are sourced, from fiscaldata's `closing_time_comp`. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN by this event's own initial research (2026-09-09), which read the single prior proposal (`proposals/treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-19.from-treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19.json`, 2026-09-08) in full first, per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md. THE ONE FINDING THAT REORDERS HOW THIS SERIES IS READ: this is the LARGEST nominal-coupon announcement of the month and of every month, and it is the one nobody watches. 2Y $69B + 5Y $70B + 7Y $44B = $183B of nominal coupons in one release, against $125B at the 2026-11-04 quarterly refunding (3Y $58B + 10Y $42B + 30Y $25B) and $35B at the 2026-11-12 announcement (20Y $16B + 10Y TIPS $19B) — so the month-end block is ~53% of November's nominal coupon dollars and 1.46x the refunding it is never compared to. Add the $28B FRN reopening and one release sizes $211B. It draws no commentary because it is front-end paper carrying almost no duration, which is a statement about WAM, not about dollars. SECOND STRUCTURAL POINT, and the reason this event is epistemically the EASIEST of its siblings rather than the hardest: sb0590 (2026-08-05, read as text direct this session, HTTP 200, 75,578 bytes) publishes six monthly rows May-26 through Oct-26, and the 2-Year, 5-Year and 7-Year columns are IDENTICAL IN ALL SIX (69 / 70 / 44). The columns that vary are 10Y (42/39), 20Y (16/13), 30Y (25/22) and FRN (30/28) — the refunding new-issue-vs-reopening cycle. This announcement's three note legs sit in the INVARIANT columns: they are new issues every month, so there is no cycle to get right, unlike the 11-12 sibling whose 20Y leg required reading the Feb/May/Aug/Nov new-issue rotation correctly. The FRN leg is the published reopening value $28B (14/14 in the tape since 2024-05-29). Tape base rates re-derived from fiscaldata auctions_query this session: 2Y $69B unchanged since 2024-04-23, 5Y $70B since 2024-04-24, 7Y $44B since 2024-04-25 — the same ~29-month, ten-refunding freeze the 11-12 sibling measured. THIRD, AND THE ONLY GENUINELY OPEN NUMBER: the bills, and specifically the 52-WEEK, which is the only MONTHLY bill on this announcement and the only leg with a live 2026 size change — it stepped 50 -> 52 at the 2026-07-07 auction (announced 07-02), its first move since 2025-07-08, and has printed $52B three times since. sb0590 states in writing that Treasury 'anticipates increasing auction sizes across the bill curve' in October for seasonal outflows. But the 52-week has NEVER changed size at a November auction in the observed record (48 auctions since 2023-01, 9 size changes, ZERO in November; the November size equalled the preceding October size 3 of 3 in 2023/2024/2025), so the 2026-10-22 announcement — which sizes the 10-27 52-week bill — is where this event's bill number is effectively set, four weeks early and for free. MEASURED AND RECORDED AS A NULL, which is this ledger's own contribution: the Thanksgiving compression does NOT degrade auction demand. Pulling every 7-Year auction since 2014 (n=152, fiscaldata), the six that sold on the day before Thanksgiving (2014-11-26, 2015-11-25, 2016-11-23, 2019-11-27, 2024-11-27, 2025-11-26) averaged bid-to-cover 2.572 against 2.490 for the other 146 and 2.556 for the 2024-05-onward regime alone, with indirect share 61.4% vs 62.3% — no degradation, a hair better. Across all three legs of the two most recent compressed blocks (2024, 2025), 5 of 6 auctions printed at or above their own series' 2024-05+ pool mean. SOURCED, NOT CONVENTION, AND A REAL HOLIDAY ARTIFACT: the pre-Thanksgiving 7-Year auction closes at 11:30 AM ET, not the standard 1:00 PM — 6 of 6 pre-Thanksgiving 7Y auctions carry `closing_time_comp: 11:30 AM`, and 6 of the 9 total 11:30 AM exceptions in 152 auctions ARE that slot (the other three are Christmas Eve 2014, Christmas Eve 2025, and 2016-02-26). Any lane researching treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25 must not assume 1:00pm ET. SESSION CONTEXT: this announcement lands ~11:00 ET and the 10-Year TIPS second reopening it does NOT size prices at 1:00pm ET the same day, so the whole Thanksgiving-week nominal block is on the tape two hours before the TIPS bidding deadline; the session also carries the 4-week and 8-week bill auctions and the settlement of the bills announced 11-12, with fomc-minutes-2026-11-18 the day before and opex-2026-11-20 the day after. Measured and NOT a Veterans Day artifact: the announcement/TIPS pairing has held 6 of 7 years 2019-2025 (the 2023 exception auctioned TIPS 11-21 and announced the 2Y 11-22), making 2026 7 of 8. THE NATURAL OWNER OF FOUR OTHERWISE-UNTRACKED AUCTIONS, three of which this PR proposes: treasury-5y-note-2026-11-24, treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25 and treasury-2y-frn-2026-11-24. treasury-2y-note-2026-11-23 was already proposed by treasury-20y-bond-2026-11-18 and is deliberately NOT duplicated. The four bill legs are deliberately not filed at all: this calendar tracks no bill auction of any tenor, and inventing the class inside an adjacency sweep would be a scope decision, not a discovery. This entry carries symbols: [] and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed; the date is estimate and nothing here licenses an entry.
